issues.detail: The Greek text includes the imperative 'αγε' (Come) at the beginning, which is missing in the Vietnamese translation.

The Greek 'ποιησωμεν εκει ενιαυτον ενα' means 'let us make there a year' (referring to a stay/duration), but the Vietnamese 'ở đó một năm' (stay there for one year) loses the active sense of 'making/spending' a year there as a collective action.
